conversation.text: You tapped "Poorly prepared". What is happening?

My onboarding training was just a single slide deck, and since my buddy has been tied up with month-end, I’ve had to rely on YouTube to learn how to post invoices. Last week I ended up posting three invoices to the wrong cost centre and had to reverse them all. What would really help me get on track is a two-hour hands-on SAP session working through real cases.

Here is what I will tell HR: The new hire reported insufficient onboarding training and having to use YouTube for invoice posting, leading to errors.
